treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — trade compliance training using compliance training system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — trade compliance training measured annually. Target: 100% staff compliance-trained. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against export control benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — trade compliance training trending toward 100% with refreshers. Escalate if <90% minimum. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using BIS EAR/ITAR framework. Report to Compliance Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 30 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >7 consecutive days, escalate to a air cargo operations and IATA compliance specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 7 days.
